archetype.name: Agentic AI Engineer / LLMs & Multi-Agent Systems
archetype.recommended_summary: AI/ML Engineer with 10+ years of technical experience designing and delivering end-to-end AI solutions, specializing in agentic AI, LLMs, RAG, and multi-agent systems. Experienced in solution architecture, agent orchestration, prompt engineering, retrieval pipelines, model evaluation, and responsible AI practices. Hands-on expertise building enterprise GenAI applications using LangChain, LangGraph, Azure AI Foundry, and observability stacks. Skilled at translating complex domain use cases into scalable, automated workflows with human-in-the-loop controls.

top_recommended_projects.name: VarEffex
top_recommended_projects.summary: Multi-agent framework that autonomously searches biomedical literature to extract variant-function associations, functional impacts, and biomarker evidence under ACMG/AMP criteria.

top_recommended_projects.name: SQL Chat
top_recommended_projects.summary: Multi-agent Streamlit application that translates natural language clinical queries to SQL, executes statistical tests, and returns interpretable Markdown summaries for researchers.

top_recommended_projects.name: Phenotype-Driven Rare Disease Prioritization Pipeline
top_recommended_projects.summary: End-to-end tertiary analysis pipeline for phenotype-based gene prioritization, variant selection, and clinical reporting in rare genetic disorders. Awarded Top Rank at Bangalore Tech Summit 2025.

top_recommended_projects.name: PathoParse
top_recommended_projects.summary: LLM-assisted and rule-based pipelines to extract structured clinical metadata and biomarker stages from unstructured pathology and histology reports for downstream analysis.

talking_points: Tailored for BioGen's Lead AI Systems Engineer opening with focus on Agentic AI Engineer / LLMs & Multi-Agent Systems.
Emphasize 10+ years of clinical & production bioinformatics and modern AI engineering.
Leverage relevant hands-on projects: VarEffex, SQL Chat, Phenotype-Driven Rare Disease Prioritization Pipeline.
